_comment: Per-site table/column mapping for the outline-leak heading repair (framework/core/article_metadata_guard.repair_leaky_headings, driven by framework/cli/article_heading_repair.py). Storage copy at config/article-heading-repair-config.json overrides this repo default. Site key matches by substring against the --site hint (agent id or bare site name). Only VALUES live here — the leak patterns themselves are logic and stay in the primitive.
